name: 하트
visual_review: 블론드 단발·베레모·붉은 눈·핑크 기타를 유지했습니다. 리듬에 따라 무릎·허리·운지·스트럼이 변하며 표정도 연주 중 미소로 바뀝니다.
motion_summary: Hart golden blonde short hair, black beret, pink-red jacket and pink electric guitar from identity. Official R strums guitar in a healing performance that makes everyone dance. Animate guitar idle; lifting fretting hand onto neck; bending knees into rhythm; first strong downstrum; left-right hip sway; rising upstroke with closed joyful eyes; second downstrum; leaning into rock solo with lifted heel; soft pink-gold circular sound rings and a few musical-note-shaped pixels at boot height; last strum; return guitar angle; original idle. Cute focused warm face with distinct eyes when open. No weapon slash, no laser, no extra dancers, no stage/scenery.
